map.试算不平衡怎么办？: What if the trial balance does not balance?
map.先查方向记反、漏记科目与金额录入错误，再核对期初余额与本期发生额的结转是否完整。: First check for reversed directions, omitted accounts and keying errors in amounts, then verify that opening balances and current-period movements were carried forward completely.
map.为什么借贷必然相等？: Why must debits and credits always be equal?
map.借贷记账法下每笔分录借贷金额相等，全部科目汇总后借贷合计必然相等，不等即说明记账: Under double-entry bookkeeping every entry has equal debits and credits, so after summarising all accounts the totals must match; a mismatch means an error in the bookkeeping process.

map.小微企业或个体工商户用模板完成记账凭证、登记账簿到出具报表的月末结账。: Small businesses and sole proprietors use the template to complete month-end closing, from accounting vouchers and ledger entries through to issuing statements.
map.凭证、账簿、报表之间的逻辑关系？: What is the logical relationship between vouchers, ledgers and statements?
map.先审核原始凭证，编制记账凭证；再据凭证登记日记账与分类账；期末调账、结账后，依据: Source documents are reviewed first and accounting vouchers prepared; the vouchers then feed the journals and ledgers; after period-end adjustments and closing, financial statements are prepared from ledger balances and movements - each step builds on the last.
map.先检查借贷是否等额、科目是否串户、漏记或重记凭证；可借助余额方向与发生额交叉核对: Check first whether debits and credits are equal and whether accounts were mixed up, omitted or recorded twice; cross-check balance directions against movements to locate the error before correcting it.
